about_the_game:
Percolator is a Roguelite Deckbuilder where you manage an up and coming cafe. Brew coffee and juggle a counter of items while scheduling tasks for your Baristas. Reinvest your profits to power up or build wealth. Discover new ways to combine ingredients so that your name goes down in history!

CREATE BARISTA SCHEDULES

No more waiting until you have ten Mana! In Percolator, Cards cost time. Play your strongest Cards right away if you want, or don't. It's up to you!

You have an unlimited amount of time each day, but your Customers grow more impatient as the day drags on. Do your best to balance making tasty coffee and keeping your customers satisfied.

MANAGE YOUR COUNTER

Your Counter is the cornerstone of your Cafe. As you create Items to serve to your Customers, they will go onto your Counter. The placement of Items on your Counter is important! So make sure to always consider not only when to play Cards, but where your Items should end up.

MASTER THE BREW

Many Items have Traits that grant special powers. Take advantage of the Brewing System to craft together different Items and combine their Traits! Explore thousands of combinations to find the playstyles that suit you. 

KEEP YOUR CUSTOMERS HAPPY

Every day brings new challenges... Your customers always have new demands and expect you to improve your game! Adapt your strategy to constantly changing orders and ensure that you get those five star ratings!

BUILD YOUR EMPIRE

Chase the dream of being a successful cafe. Carefully manage your profits and decide the best way to reinvest them. Power up your deck, purchase new equipment, or even dabble in the card market. Your dream cafe awaits - go get it!

ABOUT THE DEV

Games have always been my escape, a constant grounding force, and a way I connect with some of my best friends. From Hearthstone, to League of Legends, Stardew Valley, and countless others, a variety of games have helped to shape who I am today.

I became a developer to continue passing that forward. My goal is to design experiences that feel fresh, with mechanics that invite deep strategy and replay-ability. I hope that my games can become a meaningful part of other peoples' lives.
